daily_story.headline: Ireland remains residual-backed in this quarter-hour signal.
daily_story.interpretation: This first live-linked module uses EirGrid quarter-hourly system data where column mapping is possible. Wind and solar are measured directly where available. Residual supply is calculated as everything not identified here as wind, solar or net imports, so it should not yet be read as pure gas.

truth_meter.name: Renewable electricity
truth_meter.note: Current renewable share is material, but the pathway to an 80% renewable electricity system by 2030 remains steep.

truth_meter.name: Residual supply
truth_meter.note: This is the unclassified remainder after detected wind, solar and imports. It should not be read as measured gas until a true fuel-mix source is wired.

truth_meter.name: Grid carbon intensity
truth_meter.note: Carbon intensity improves when wind is high, but the system remains sensitive to gas generation.

truth_meter.name: Energy affordability
truth_meter.note: Household electricity and gas costs remain a social constraint on transition legitimacy.

truth_meter.name: EV transition
truth_meter.note: New electric vehicle uptake is improving, but fleet turnover remains slower than headline sales suggest.

truth_meter.name: Heat transition
truth_meter.note: Home heating is harder to decarbonise than electricity and needs separate public tracking.

target_drift.interpretation: Ireland reached 41.3% renewable electricity in 2024. To reach 80% by 2030, the remaining gap is 38.7 percentage points, requiring about 6.45 percentage points per year from 2024.
target_drift.caveat: This is an annual official RES-E indicator. It is not the same as the live quarter-hourly electricity mix shown in the Energy Now section.

prices.label: Household electricity
prices.detail: Latest official SEAI semester: 2025S1; up 1.13 c/kWh from previous period; 2.38 c/kWh above EU-27. Not a live supplier tariff.

prices.label: Household gas
prices.detail: Latest official SEAI semester: 2025S1; down 1.35 c/kWh from previous period; 0.65 c/kWh above EU-27. Not a live supplier tariff.

prices.label: Transport fuels
prices.detail: Transport-fuel price layer not yet wired. Planned after electricity and gas.

gas.narrative: Residual supply is currently calculated as demand not covered by detected wind, solar and net imports. A later fuel-mix harvester should split this into gas, hydro, storage, coal/oil and other sources.

source_status.source: EirGrid System Data Qtr Hourly spreadsheet
source_status.caveat: Best-effort parser. Residual is not pure gas.

county_hosting.title: County Hosting Index
county_hosting.caveat: Imported from local SEAI dashboard export CSV. SEAI describes the dashboard as beta; some generation values may be estimated and should not be used for official reporting.

method.index: 0 to 100 score from total MWh, MWh/km² and population-density-normalised metrics where present
method.display: Schematic tile heatmap, not boundary-accurate geography

summary.spatial_question: Who hosts renewable infrastructure, who consumes electricity, and where is the transition uneven?
